explanationIssues: The explanation and the ニ choice explanation both state that ニ "is a CV cable". Recommended wording: "ニ is a round cable (black sheath with filler and tape), not the flat VVF specified for lighting circuits." If the text keeps the word CV, mark it as inferred from appearance.

All match the candidate descriptions. Page 15 wiring diagram: ⑯ points to the riser symbol (small circle and arrow) beside the ceiling light labelled ハ on the 1st-floor stairs. The 1st-floor stairs also have a 3-way switch marked "3 ハ" (●). On the 2nd floor, the switch group イロハ (●●●) marks ハ with "3", and its line runs to the pull-down symbol at the stairs. ① runs from the hatched-circle junction box ⑬ to the switch group. explanationIssues: The parenthetical in the explanation ("where there is no risk of pressure from vehicles or other heavy objects, covering the top of the cable with a sturdy board or similar is also allowed") paraphrases 電技解釈 第120条 第4項. The wording has not been checked against the source text, including which voltage classes it applies to and the exact phrase "堅ろうな板又はとい". Quote the clause verbatim after checking the source, or delete the parenthetical.

The イ choice explanation says the warning sheet signals "at the surface or at a shallow depth". A buried warning sheet is laid in the soil above the cable and warns people when they dig. It does not signal at the surface, so "地表" is wrong. Recommended wording: "a buried warning sheet laid above the cable to warn during excavation."

The ハ choice explanation states outright that ハ is "pipe used to build an underground duct run (管路式)", which is a guess from the photo. The main explanation hedges ("波付硬質合成樹脂管などの可とう管"), so the two are inconsistent. Align them by describing ハ as "a flexible corrugated pipe, not a trough".
sourceIssues: The explanation makes a regulatory claim based on 電技解釈 第120条 第4項 (direct burial requires a sturdy trough or other protection), but officialReferenceUrls is empty. The METI texts could not be fetched: WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for https://www.meti.go.jp/policy/safety_security/industrial_safety/law/files/dengikaishaku.pdf and https://www.meti.go.jp/policy/safety_security/industrial_safety/law/files/dengikaishakukaisetsu.pdf. explanationIssues: The explanation for ロ says the meaning of the "15" label cannot be determined from the image, which leaves an admitted ambiguity. Replace it with what can be seen: ロ has no three-phase 3-terminal cover and no "三相200V" rating label like イ. Do not make claims about its internal structure or what it is.

Both explanations state outright that ハ is a molded-case circuit breaker (配線用遮断器). The deciding point is that ハ has no capacitor rating. Recommended wording: "a 3-pole breaker with a 10A rating label; it has no capacitance (μF) rating."
